description: Change-size guardrails: soft threshold = warn, hard threshold = block. Override any PR-time block with a commit-message line 'SIZE-OVERRIDE: <reason>' in the range merge-base(origin/main,HEAD)..HEAD; override a plan-time block with a 'SIZE-OVERRIDE: <reason>' line inside the plan's '## Change-size' section.

branch._ageNote: age = wall-clock now minus the committer timestamp of the branch's first unique commit

plan._forge: milestoneShipToken is forge terminology. On GitLab set it to '→ MR' (Gitea/Forgejo also say PR); plan_size.py reads the token from here, nothing else changes.

_calibration: Placeholder thresholds. Calibrate before trusting the block tier: iterate recent single-purpose commits on main (git log --format=%H -20 origin/main; git diff --numstat <c>^..<c>) or read per-PR stats from your forge's API. If the repo merges fast-forward-only, git log --merges finds nothing — measure commits, not merge commits.
